description: Target manifest for Heatwave and Data-Dependent Severe-Wind Reliability Specialist, covering threshold exceedance, peak temperature, onset timing, duration, warm nights, spatial extent, and gale gusts.

invariants.decomposed_evaluation: Threshold exceedance, peak temperature, onset, duration, warm night, spatial extent, and severe wind must be evaluated independently without collapsing into an opaque single score.
invariants.anti_leakage: All evaluation features strictly constrained to issue time t0. Verification against gridded maximum/minimum temperature and hourly gust observations sealed with 24h verification latency.
invariants.data_dependent_wind_activation: Severe wind evaluation is strictly activated on paired forecast/reference datasets meeting Gate 0 data availability contracts.
invariants.regional_conditioning: Validation must be partitioned across Core Heatwave Zone, Northwest Plains, Coastal Peninsular, and Hill Region domains.

targets.name: Heatwave Occurrence Threshold Exceedance Failure
targets.description: Binary failure to predict heatwave occurrence (Tmax >= 40.0°C and departure >= 4.5°C in plains, Tmax >= 37.0°C in coastal, or Tmax >= 30.0°C in hills) or false alarm with forecast error > 2.5°C.

targets.name: Heatwave Peak Maximum Temperature Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast daily peak maximum temperature absolute error |Tmax_fc - Tmax_obs| exceeding 2.5°C.

targets.name: Heatwave Onset Timing Error Exceedance
targets.description: Heatwave spell onset timing error exceeding 24.0 hours.

targets.name: Heatwave Spell Duration Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast heatwave persistence and spell duration error exceeding 48.0 hours (2 days).

targets.name: Warm Night Minimum Temperature Departure Error Exceedance
targets.description: Warm night minimum temperature departure error exceeding 2.0°C when Tmax >= 40.0°C.

targets.name: Heatwave Spatial Extent Area Coverage Error Exceedance
targets.description: Regional spatial extent area coverage fraction error exceeding 20% of the contiguous climatic zone.

targets.name: Severe Wind Gale Gust Exceedance Error
targets.description: Forecast 10m wind gust absolute error exceeding 6.0 m/s on gale-force events (>= 17.2 m/s / 62 km/h); evaluated conditionally on paired data.
